svg.title: EasyTrip app flow: 1 · Overview
svg.text: • Explore → destinations.html and winter / spring / summer / autumn.html
• Hotels & chalets → hotels.html, chalets.html (search, filter, sort, details)
• Plan a trip → flight.html, bus-train.html (validated form + summary)
• Login, reservations, admin → planned Node.js + Express API and MySQL

text.tspan: Page 1 of 2 · Overview: what a visitor, a customer and an admin can do, from start to stop
No / invalid: go back and fix
Reservation: starts from “Book this stay” or “Reserve this trip”
